metadata.definition: One row per person listed on a faculty page cited by the universities database, per university, with the department rows that cite the page. The page lists the name under the title shown; nothing else is established by the listing. "om-list" rows are the same person as an OM List profile (same name and university) and carry that profile's source-reported doctorate, research status and verified first job; "om-list-name-only" rows share a name with one OM List profile at another institution and may be a namesake; "unverified" rows have no doctorate or first job known until a reviewer opens the person's own page and records the outcome under review. Extraction is heuristic and listed names can be wrong or incomplete; a page that blocks automated fetches or renders its list with scripts contributes nothing and is reported under pages.
